title: Parsley, Lemon and Garlic Gremolata
summary: Very finely chopped parsley, garlic and lemon zest tossed together.

ingredients.item: flat-leaf parsley leaves, very finely chopped

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Chop the parsley very finely with a dry, sharp knife.

steps.title: Zest
steps.text: Grate only the yellow layer of the lemon; the white pith is bitter.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Toss the parsley, garlic and zest together in the bowl.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter straight away over braised beef shank, stews, roast fish or vegetables.

tips: Dry the parsley well so the mix stays fluffy.
Make it just before serving for the best colour and aroma.
Add a little orange zest for a softer citrus flavour.
storage: Best fresh; keep covered in the fridge for up to 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
